title: OOM building on x86 with default LTO

body_preview: ### Summary  As of 0.16.10, builds on x86 fail with OOM (keep in mind that there's an architectural memory limit here). title: [pydocstyle] Flag placeholder docstrings like `"""Function docstring."""
author: rohitsaboo
body_preview: Generated code (AI-slop) often carries docstrings that satisfy D100-D107 but say nothing: `"""Module docstring."""`, `"""Function docstring."""`, `"""Class docstring."""`.  We found >100 in one codebase. A rule matching a configurable list of placeholder patterns (default: those three, `"""TODO."""`, `"""Docstring."""`) would catch them, since D1xx counts them as present.

title: Nested .gitignore negations can never re-include what an ancestor excluded
author: KaizenShogun
body_preview: **Describe the bug**  A negation in a nested `.gitignore` can never re-include something an ancestor `.gitignore` excluded. Git decides the other way round: the *deepest* gitignore file that has a matching pattern wins, and only inside that file does last-match-win. Black ORs across gitignore files, so the deepest one — the only one that can say `!` — is often never consulted.  Effect: `black .` s...
